description: A condition in which blood glucose remains higher than normal.
common_symptoms: Increased thirst;frequent urination;fatigue;blurred vision;slow wound healing
prevention: Balanced diet;regular physical activity;healthy weight;regular screening
when_to_see_doctor: Persistent symptoms or repeatedly abnormal glucose readings.
general_precautions: Do not change prescribed medicines without medical advice.

description: Persistently high blood pressure that can increase cardiovascular and kidney risk.
prevention: Regular BP checks;physical activity;healthy diet;limit excess salt
when_to_see_doctor: Repeatedly high BP readings or concerning symptoms.
general_precautions: Do not stop or change prescribed BP medicines yourself.

description: A chronic condition involving inflammation and narrowing of the airways.
prevention: Avoid known triggers;follow prescribed asthma plan;avoid tobacco smoke
when_to_see_doctor: Frequent or worsening symptoms or breathing difficulty.
general_precautions: Use prescribed medicines according to the treatment plan.

description: A medical emergency caused by reduced or blocked blood flow to heart muscle.
common_symptoms: Chest pressure;shortness of breath;sweating;nausea;arm or jaw discomfort
prevention: Avoid tobacco;healthy diet;physical activity;manage BP and cholesterol
when_to_see_doctor: Suspected heart attack requires immediate emergency care.
general_precautions: Do not delay emergency medical treatment.

description: A medical emergency caused by interrupted blood flow to the brain or bleeding in the brain.
common_symptoms: Face drooping;arm weakness;speech difficulty;vision problems;balance problems
prevention: Control BP;avoid tobacco;manage diabetes and cholesterol
when_to_see_doctor: Sudden stroke warning signs require immediate emergency care.
general_precautions: Note when symptoms started and seek emergency help.

description: A sudden worsening of asthma symptoms that can cause significant breathing difficulty.
common_symptoms: Severe wheezing;shortness of breath;chest tightness;difficulty speaking
when_to_see_doctor: Severe breathing difficulty or poor response to prescribed rescue treatment.
general_precautions: Follow the person's prescribed emergency asthma plan.

description: A common viral infection of the upper respiratory tract.
risk_factors: Contact with infected people;respiratory virus exposure
prevention: Hand hygiene;cover coughs;avoid close contact when ill
when_to_see_doctor: Severe or persistent symptoms need medical evaluation.
general_precautions: Rest and maintain adequate fluid intake.

description: A contagious respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses.
prevention: Vaccination when recommended;hand hygiene;stay home when ill
when_to_see_doctor: Severe symptoms or worsening illness.
general_precautions: Follow medical advice and avoid unnecessary antibiotics.

description: A respiratory infection caused by SARS-CoV-2.
prevention: Follow current vaccination and public-health guidance;good ventilation
when_to_see_doctor: Breathing difficulty;chest pain;confusion or worsening symptoms.
general_precautions: Follow current medical and public-health guidance.

description: A neurological condition causing recurring headache attacks.
when_to_see_doctor: New sudden severe or significantly changed headache.
general_precautions: Keep a headache diary and seek medical assessment.

description: Inflammation or irritation of the stomach lining.
risk_factors: H. pylori infection;some medicines;alcohol;other stomach conditions
when_to_see_doctor: Persistent symptoms or signs of bleeding.
general_precautions: Do not stop prescribed medicines without advice.

description: An infection of the lungs that may range from mild to serious.
when_to_see_doctor: Breathing difficulty;chest pain;confusion or worsening symptoms.
general_precautions: Seek medical assessment for severe symptoms.

description: A condition involving reduced healthy red blood cells or hemoglobin.
when_to_see_doctor: Persistent fatigue or suspected blood loss.
general_precautions: Do not self-prescribe iron supplements without assessment.

description: Excess body fat that can increase the risk of several health conditions.
common_symptoms: May have no specific symptoms;reduced exercise tolerance
when_to_see_doctor: Persistent weight concerns or related health problems.
general_precautions: Avoid extreme diets and unverified weight-loss products.

description: A chronic lung condition causing persistent airflow limitation.
prevention: Avoid tobacco;reduce harmful exposures;follow treatment plans
when_to_see_doctor: Increasing breathlessness or persistent respiratory symptoms.
general_precautions: Seek urgent care for severe breathing difficulty.

description: A bacterial infection that most often affects the lungs.
when_to_see_doctor: Persistent cough or concerning symptoms.
general_precautions: Follow prescribed treatment exactly if diagnosed.

description: A mosquito-borne viral infection.
risk_factors: Mosquito exposure;travel or residence in risk areas
when_to_see_doctor: Warning signs or worsening illness require medical care.
general_precautions: Avoid self-medication that may increase bleeding risk.

description: A mosquito-borne infection caused by Plasmodium parasites.
risk_factors: Mosquito exposure;travel or residence in endemic areas
when_to_see_doctor: Fever after travel or residence in a malaria-risk area.
general_precautions: Prompt testing and treatment are important.

description: Frequent loose or watery stools that can cause dehydration.
when_to_see_doctor: Severe dehydration;blood in stool;severe or persistent symptoms.
general_precautions: Maintain fluids and seek care when severe.

description: Infrequent or difficult bowel movements.
when_to_see_doctor: Persistent symptoms;severe pain;vomiting or blood in stool.
general_precautions: Avoid repeated laxative use without professional advice.

description: A condition in which stomach contents flow back into the esophagus.
when_to_see_doctor: Frequent symptoms or difficulty swallowing.
general_precautions: Do not assume severe chest pain is simple heartburn.

description: Hard deposits that form in the kidneys.
common_symptoms: Severe side or back pain;blood in urine;nausea;urinary symptoms
when_to_see_doctor: Severe pain;fever;vomiting or difficulty urinating.
general_precautions: Seek medical evaluation for severe symptoms.

description: An infection affecting parts of the urinary tract.
when_to_see_doctor: Fever;flank pain;pregnancy or worsening symptoms.
general_precautions: Do not use leftover antibiotics.

description: A joint condition involving changes to cartilage and surrounding tissues.
when_to_see_doctor: Persistent pain;swelling or loss of function.
general_precautions: Use treatment plans recommended by a professional.

description: A condition in which bones become weaker and more likely to fracture.
common_symptoms: Often no symptoms until fracture;back pain;loss of height
when_to_see_doctor: Fracture after minor injury or significant risk factors.
general_precautions: Discuss screening and prevention with a clinician.

description: A mental health condition involving persistent low mood or loss of interest.
common_symptoms: Persistent sadness;loss of interest;fatigue;sleep changes;poor concentration
when_to_see_doctor: Persistent symptoms or thoughts of self-harm require prompt help.
general_precautions: Seek emergency help for immediate safety concerns.

description: A condition involving excessive fear or worry that can interfere with daily life.
when_to_see_doctor: Symptoms interfering with daily activities.
general_precautions: Seek professional assessment rather than self-diagnosing.

description: A neurological disorder characterized by recurrent unprovoked seizures.
when_to_see_doctor: First seizure;prolonged seizure;repeated seizures or injury.
general_precautions: Do not stop anti-seizure medication abruptly.

description: A progressive neurological disorder affecting movement and other functions.
when_to_see_doctor: New or worsening movement symptoms.
general_precautions: Treatment should be individualized by professionals.

description: Conditions involving abnormal thyroid hormone production or function.
prevention: Medical assessment when at risk;appropriate nutrition
when_to_see_doctor: Persistent symptoms or thyroid swelling.
general_precautions: Do not start thyroid medicines or supplements without advice.

description: A hormonal disorder that can affect ovulation and metabolism.
when_to_see_doctor: Irregular periods or fertility concerns.
general_precautions: Diagnosis requires clinical assessment.

description: A chronic condition involving tissue similar to uterine lining growing outside the uterus.
common_symptoms: Pelvic pain;painful periods;pain during sex;fertility problems
when_to_see_doctor: Severe or persistent pelvic pain or fertility concerns.
general_precautions: Seek gynecological evaluation.

description: Long-term kidney damage or reduced kidney function.
prevention: Control BP and glucose;avoid tobacco;regular monitoring
when_to_see_doctor: Abnormal kidney tests;swelling or persistent urinary changes.
general_precautions: Avoid unapproved medicines or supplements.

description: A condition in which the heart cannot pump enough blood for the body's needs.
when_to_see_doctor: New or worsening breathlessness or swelling.
general_precautions: Follow the prescribed care plan.

description: An abnormal heart rhythm that may be fast, slow or irregular.
when_to_see_doctor: Fainting;chest pain;severe breathlessness or persistent palpitations.
general_precautions: Seek emergency care for severe symptoms.

description: High levels of certain blood lipids can increase cardiovascular risk.
when_to_see_doctor: Discuss abnormal lipid results with a healthcare professional.
general_precautions: Do not start or stop lipid medicines without advice.

description: Repeated interruption of breathing during sleep.
common_symptoms: Loud snoring;gasping during sleep;daytime sleepiness;morning headaches
prevention: Healthy weight when appropriate;avoid tobacco;medical evaluation
when_to_see_doctor: Habitual loud snoring or significant daytime sleepiness.
general_precautions: Avoid driving when excessively sleepy.

description: Difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep or getting restorative sleep.
when_to_see_doctor: Persistent sleep problems affecting daytime function.
general_precautions: Avoid relying on sleep medicines without guidance.

description: An allergic reaction affecting the nose.
when_to_see_doctor: Persistent symptoms affecting sleep or daily life.
general_precautions: Avoid known triggers and follow treatment advice.

description: A group of conditions causing itchy and inflamed skin.
when_to_see_doctor: Severe;infected or persistent skin changes.
general_precautions: Avoid scratching and seek assessment for infection.

description: A chronic immune-mediated skin condition.
when_to_see_doctor: Extensive;painful or persistent symptoms.
general_precautions: Treatment should be individualized.

description: A common condition involving blocked hair follicles and inflammation.
when_to_see_doctor: Severe;scarring or persistent acne.
general_precautions: Avoid squeezing lesions.

description: Inflammation or infection of the conjunctiva.
when_to_see_doctor: Eye pain;vision changes or light sensitivity.
general_precautions: Avoid sharing eye drops.

description: Clouding of the eye's natural lens that can affect vision.
when_to_see_doctor: Progressive vision changes affecting activities.
general_precautions: Eye examination is needed.

description: A group of diseases that can damage the optic nerve.
common_symptoms: Often no early symptoms;peripheral vision loss later
when_to_see_doctor: Vision changes or high-risk screening needs.
general_precautions: Vision loss can be permanent;seek eye care.

description: Reduced ability to hear sounds in one or both ears.
common_symptoms: Difficulty understanding speech;asking for repetition;ringing ears
when_to_see_doctor: Sudden hearing loss requires urgent assessment.
general_precautions: Do not insert objects into the ear canal.

description: Inflammation of the sinuses that may follow infection or occur with allergies.
when_to_see_doctor: Persistent;severe or worsening symptoms.
general_precautions: Seek care for severe facial pain or swelling.

description: Inflammation of the bronchial tubes, often due to viral infection when acute.
when_to_see_doctor: Breathing difficulty;blood in sputum;prolonged symptoms.
general_precautions: Avoid unnecessary antibiotics unless prescribed.

description: Pain in the back with many possible causes.
when_to_see_doctor: Severe pain;weakness;numbness;fever;trauma or bladder/bowel changes.
general_precautions: Seek urgent assessment for neurological warning signs.

description: A condition caused by losing more fluid than the body takes in.
when_to_see_doctor: Confusion;fainting;very low urination or inability to keep fluids down.
general_precautions: Seek medical help for severe dehydration.

description: Illness caused by contaminated food or drink.
when_to_see_doctor: Severe dehydration;blood in stool;high fever or persistent symptoms.
general_precautions: Maintain fluids and seek care when severe.

description: An immune reaction to a food that can sometimes be severe.
prevention: Avoid known allergens;read labels;emergency plan when prescribed
when_to_see_doctor: Breathing difficulty;throat swelling;faintness requires emergency care.
general_precautions: Follow the prescribed allergy emergency plan.

description: A severe potentially life-threatening allergic reaction.
prevention: Avoid known triggers;carry prescribed emergency medication
when_to_see_doctor: Immediate emergency care is required.
general_precautions: Use prescribed emergency medication when indicated and seek emergency care.

description: A life-threatening response to infection that can cause organ dysfunction.
common_symptoms: Confusion;rapid breathing;fever or low temperature;fast heart rate;extreme weakness
when_to_see_doctor: Suspected sepsis requires urgent emergency assessment.
general_precautions: Do not delay emergency evaluation.

description: A group of diseases involving abnormal cells that may invade or spread.
common_symptoms: Symptoms vary;unexplained weight loss;lump;persistent cough;unusual bleeding
when_to_see_doctor: Persistent unexplained symptoms or abnormal screening results.
general_precautions: Screening depends on age and risk.

description: Tobacco use increases the risk of many diseases and harms nearly every organ.
when_to_see_doctor: Discuss tobacco dependence and cessation with a professional.
general_precautions: Avoid unverified products marketed as treatments.

description: A healthy diet supports overall health through balance, diversity and moderation.
risk_factors: Unbalanced diet;excess salt;sugar or unhealthy fats
when_to_see_doctor: Disease-specific or persistent nutrition concerns need professional advice.
general_precautions: Avoid extreme restrictive diets.

description: Regular physical activity supports cardiovascular, metabolic and mental health.
common_symptoms: Not a disease;low fitness may occur with inactivity
when_to_see_doctor: Discuss safe exercise levels when significant health conditions exist.
general_precautions: Increase activity gradually.

description: An elevated body temperature that can occur with infection and other conditions.
when_to_see_doctor: Severe or persistent fever or concerning symptoms need assessment.
general_precautions: Do not judge severity from temperature alone.

description: A protective reflex with many possible causes.
prevention: Avoid tobacco smoke;hand hygiene;manage known conditions
when_to_see_doctor: Persistent cough;coughing blood or breathing difficulty requires assessment.
general_precautions: Seek urgent care for severe breathing difficulty.
